issue.title: 'arrow' has no attribute 'utcnow'
issue.body:
<!--
Thanks for taking the time to submit this bug report.

Please provide us with a detailed description of the bug and a bit of information about your system.
-->

i installed arrow module in deferents python versions and followed the examples from docs but always it is showing me the same error with the next code:
```
import arrow
utc = arrow.utcnow()
print(utc)
```

error:
utc = arrow.utcnow()
AttributeError: partially initialized module 'arrow' has no attribute 'utcnow' (most likely due to a circular import)


## System Info

- 🖥  **OS name and version**: macOS 11.7.10 
- 🐍  **Python version**: Python 3.10
- 🏹  **Arrow version**: 1.2.3

extraction.central_claim: The 'arrow' module does not have a 'utcnow' attribute when the reporter tries to use it.

symptom.quote: AttributeError: partially initialized module 'arrow' has no attribute 'utcnow' (most likely due to a circular import)

commands: docker run --name bb-7616ce477dd5-install -e SETUPTOOLS_SCM_PRETEND_VERSION=1.2.3 --cpus 1 --memory 1g --pids-limit 256 --mount type=bind,source=$TMPDIR/bigbrother-hrfdt83t/src,target=/src --mount type=volume,source=bb-7616ce477dd5-deps,target=/deps bigbrother-sandbox:0.1 sh -c 'uv venv /deps/venv --python /usr/local/bin/python3 && uv pip install --python /deps/venv/bin/python -e /src; status=$?; if [ $status -eq 0 ]; then echo bigbrother-1b528bfe377a4ddf840f51bda684a179; uv pip freeze --python /deps/venv/bin/python; fi; chmod -R a+rwX /src 2>/dev/null; exit $status'

docker run --name bb-7616ce477dd5-run --network none --read-only --tmpfs /tmp:size=64m --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges --user 1000:1000 --pids-limit 128 --memory 1g --cpus 1 --mount type=bind,source=$TMPDIR/bigbrother-hrfdt83t/src,target=/src,readonly --mount type=volume,source=bb-7616ce477dd5-deps,target=/deps,readonly --mount type=bind,source=$TMPDIR/bigbrother-hrfdt83t/repro.py,target=/repro.py,readonly --workdir /tmp bigbrother-sandbox:0.1 sh -c '/deps/venv/bin/python -c '"'"'import contextlib, importlib, io, sys
try:
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()), contextlib.redirect_stderr(io.StringIO()):
        module = importlib.import_module(sys.argv[1])
except BaseException:
    sys.exit(0)
path = getattr(module, "__file__", None) or next(iter(getattr(module, "__path__", [])), "")
print(sys.argv[2])
print(path)
'"'"' arrow bigbrother-1b528bfe377a4ddf840f51bda684a179 2>/dev/null; exec /deps/venv/bin/python /repro.py'
